author: TropicaICrayon
body:
Hello, I am TropicaICrayon. I came on the server for the first time today to play on it with a few of my friends, who happen to share similar names with me. I was simply playing the game, when one of my friends encountered an issue in which he spawned on the observer platform with no items every time he died, and the moderators were doing nothing about it. I was simply asking for help, when I was kicked by the moderator Aerosmith for having various warnings, of which I had been given none. I was confused about that, and returned to the game to confront the moderator concerning his actions. Shortly after posing my question, the moderator VenemousViper proceeded to kick me once again for disrespecting Aerosmith, when all I had done was pose a question, of which was never answered. I simply proceeded to play the game as normal, not saying anything, when out of the blue, the administrator Straightened. I am very confused as to why I was banned. I can live with the kicks, but I would like to be able to play the game again with my friends TropicalCrayon, TropicalCrayons, TropicarClayon, and Tropical_Crayon.

Thank you for your time.

title: Temp Ban and Kick Appeals

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Looking at the logs I have decided to deny your appeal.

Your Temp-ban is valid and will not be appealed.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Mod.
